opening.argument: The speaker creates urgency around an XRP event, telling viewers to “sign up right now” through a link and emphasizing that it will have “a limited number of seats.” Access to the promoted VIP experience is presented as dependent on joining the Digital Perspectives mastermind group, described as “the only way you can get it.” The listed links are identified as “affiliate or paid promotions and deals,” providing context for the event and membership solicitation. Although no price or completed transaction is supplied, these combined invitations and access restrictions establish a token-purchase, appreciation, or dividends solicitation. The surrounding XRP discussion includes an investment disclaimer and risk warning, but those qualifications do not eliminate the separately described event promotion.
